Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 40

“The senses, the mind, and the understanding are said to be its seat. Through these it deludes the embodied one by covering knowledge.”

Krishna maps the enemy's territory before attacking it. Desire is not located in objects out there but occupies three positions inside, each one further in than the last.
